title: Extension Charge for Added Nights on a Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
The extension charge on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is the charge for the added nights booked by a signed extension, shown on the stay statement as one extension segment.

## Elements of the charge

- **The added nights** run from the planned departure date on record up to the requested date, that is the requested date less the planned departure date in calendar days. The requested date is the date stated on the extension request registered on the stay.
- **The nightly rate locked at booking** is the locked nightly rate recorded on the stay.
- **The added-night rate** is the nightly rate locked at booking.
- **The care increase on an added night** is the added-night rate less the nightly rate locked at booking.
- **The price of an added night** is the nightly rate locked at booking plus the care increase on an added night.
- **The extension charge** is the added nights times the price of an added night, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final total.

Taken together, the extension charge is the added nights times the nightly rate locked at booking.

## Worked statement (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) is locked at 284.00 a night with a planned departure date of 20 May on record; the extension request states 25 May.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Added nights: 25 May less 20 May | 5 |
| Added-night rate | 284.00 |
| Care increase on an added night: 284.00 less 284.00 | 0.00 |
| Price of an added night | 284.00 |
| Extension charge: 5 times 284.00 | 1,420.00 |

## Points of reading

- The first added night is the night of the planned departure date on record; the requested date itself is the new departure date and is not an added night.
- The rate read is the locked nightly rate on the stay record, whatever the stay type's published rate is on the day of the extension.
- Rounding is applied once, to the final total.
